population: All strictly paired original/refined validation+test records; no gate filtering

definitions.english_words: ASCII Latin words including apostrophized/hyphenated compounds; Dance style header removed; recomputed from motion_caption
definitions.final_sents: Producer sents field, not independently semantic sentence validation
definitions.original_events: Nonempty Chinese full-stop-separated statements in target_windows captions, concatenated once across windows
definitions.gate: Producer automatic check; not human or visual quality approval
definitions.style: Existing source metadata, not an independent inferred class; unknown retained
definitions.histogram_overflow: Final large edge 100000 is display overflow, labelled >=180 words / >=80 events / >=10 sentences

limits: Original Chinese event statements and final English sentences are different units; their counts demonstrate compression/organization only, not higher action diversity.
Raw 16-class event vocabulary versus free prose vocabulary is not a comparable action-space measure.
No verified before/after action-class coverage claimed; lexical mentions can change through paraphrase and do not prove factual coverage.
Gate filtering changes retained metadata distribution only, not demonstrated caption quality.
Full corpus final distribution is 220667; original-final paired distributions cover val+test only, not full corpus.
No video/audio downloaded or read for this audit; no inference or quality judging performed.

research_references.lesson: Report language/motion resource characteristics; do not equate lexical frequencies with semantic diversity.
Keep annotation granularity and temporal segment support explicit.
Audit body-part information and genre coverage; retain unknown style metadata.
